जप् {c1c} P. (जपति, जपित or जप्त)
1 To
utter in a low voice, repeat
internally, mutter; जपन्नपि तवैवालापमंत्रावलिं
Gīt. 5
; हरिरिति हरिरिति जपति सकामं
Gīt. 4

.
--3 To pray to one or invoke in a
low voice.

जप a. [जप्-कर्तरि अच्]
1
Muttering, whispering.
--पः {1} Muttering
prayers, repeating prayers &c. in an
under-tone.
--2 Repeating passages of
the Veda or names of deities &c.;

.
--3 A muttered
prayer.
--4 Counting silently the
beads of a rosary &c.
--Comp.
--परायण
a. engaged in muttering prayers.
--माला a rosary of beads.
--यज्ञः,
--होमः muttering prayers as a
sacrifice.

जपा [जप्-अच् टाप्] The China
rose (the plant or its flower); सांध्यं
तेजः प्रतिनवजपापुष्परक्तं दधानः
Me. 36

जपनं [जप्-भावे ल्युट्] The
muttering of prayers.

1 Declining, rejection.
--2
Dismissing, sending away.
--3
Completing, finishing.

जप्य a. [जप् कर्मणि यत्] To be
repeated in a low voice, muttered, or
whispered.
--प्यः, --प्यं A muttered
prayer.

जाप्य a. To be muttered.
--प्यं
A prayer to be muttered in a low
voice.

जापः [जप्-घञ्]
1 Muttering
prayers, whispering, murmuring.
--2 A muttered prayer.

जापक a. Muttering prayers.
--कं
A kind of fragrant wood.
